guitar.guitaristsText: John Lennon / George Harrison / Paul McCartney
guitar.modelsText: Rickenbacker 325/360-12, Gretsch, Epiphone Casino, Gibson J-160E
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: well documented across multiple guitars and eras — Lennon's Rickenbacker 325/Casino, Harrison's Gretsch/Rickenbacker 360-12, McCartney mainly bass (Hofner) with some guitar use.
guitar.notes: Original entry reasonable as a summary across three members and many guitars; kept as-is.

tone.target: dry bluesy rhythm with wah-muted bite and thick low-mid crunch
tone.profile: dry bluesy rhythm with wah-muted bite and thick low-mid crunch
tone.summary: A vintage Marshall-style crunch tone using Blues OD for grit, followed by a Wah pedal accent. The sound is shaped by the UK 45 amp model and US 2x12 cab to maintain a dry, focused rhythm bite.
corrections: Aim for riff bite, not warm generic crunch

rig.name: The Beatles - Come Together - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide low-gain grit and the required 'dirty' bite without high gain.
Implement the core 'wah pedal accents' and filter bite.
Bypass (or use a subtle boost if needed for extra punch).
blocks.gap: The Blues OD handles the required grit; no dedicated distortion is necessary.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the Marshall-ish crunch and provide thick low-mid emphasis.
Achieve the required 'dry close-mic feel' and focused tone.
blocks.gap: While a 4x12 was suggested, US 2x12 provides a tighter, more focused sound suitable for dry rhythm work.

blocks.purpose: Boost the low-mids specifically for 'thick low-mid emphasis' and punch.

blocks.gap: The required tone is dry; all modulation effects are bypassed.
The required tone is dry; all time-based effects are bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Provide minimal, natural ambience without sounding 'big' or wet.
blocks.gap: The verdict suggests keeping it dry; this is a subtle touch to prevent the sound from being too sterile.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to better capture the desired thick low-mid crunch and punch required for The Beatles' rhythm style.

proposals.reason: A 4x12 is more appropriate for the Marshall-ish crunch and low-mid punch.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased girth and definition in the low-mids.
